你把停手休息的时间写进安排。护目镜摘下来，喝口水，等眼睛缓过来再继续。: You write rest breaks into your schedule. You take off the goggles, drink some water, and wait for your eyes to recover before continuing.
五十岁了，你不再接连赶几班。手停下来的时候，能慢慢活动肩膀，也把防护用品查一遍。: At fifty, you no longer rush several shifts in a row. When your hands stop, you can slowly loosen your shoulders and check your protective gear.
你把额外加班减下来。机器停稳以后，量具擦净收好，饭不再总是凉了才吃。: You cut back extra overtime. Once the machine has stopped, you wipe the gauges clean and put them away, and your meals no longer go cold before you eat.
五十岁了，你不把排班接满。下班铃响过，交清尺寸记录就走，晚上能留一点时间给自己。: At fifty, you don't fill every shift. When the closing bell rings, you hand in the dimension records and go, leaving a little time for yourself in the evening.
你给两个工期之间留了空当。上一家的边角收好，再去下一家，不再来回赶场。: You leave a gap between two jobs. You finish the edges at the previous place before going to the next, no longer dashing back and forth.
五十岁了，你把赶不及的活提前说清。一天做完就收工具，膝盖累了不再硬跪着赶。: At fifty, you say in advance which jobs you can't make in time. When the day's work is done you put the tools away, and no longer force yourself to kneel on tired knees.

花 ¥10,000 学鲜食和冷链管理: Spend ¥10,000 learning fresh-food and cold-chain management
你记下验温和盘损耗的办法，回来帮着照看鲜食货架。机器和进货的钱仍由店里安排。: You note down how to check temperatures and count spoilage, then help tend the fresh-food shelves. The money for equipment and stock is still arranged by the store.
